metaTitle: How to Wash and Dry a Sleeping Bag
description: Step-by-step sleeping bag washing and drying for down and synthetic bags: the right machine, cleaner, low-heat drying and how to restore loft.
directAnswer: Wash only when needed in a large front-loader with a down or technical cleaner, rinse twice, then dry on low heat with dryer balls until completely dry. Skip softener, bleach and agitator top-loaders.
